currentParagraphText: “Sir, here,” the Viper said, hurriedly reaching into his spatial storage and taking out a red potion.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Sir, here,” the Viper said, hurriedly reaching into his spatial storage and taking out a red potion.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: The man looked at it with surprise for a moment before quickly accepting it. At the same time, the Viper also took out two other bottles, handing one to the woman. “Here, drink; it’s a resistance flask.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Dad... Dad, what happened?” the beastkin woman asked with concern as she kneeled down beside her father. The Viper also moved closer, a face full of concern. A perimeter of guards surrounded them, leaving only the Viper, his assumed girlfriend, and the auctioneer within. Alongside the Eye of the Magus, of course.
